analysis.reason: RSI가 과매도 구간으로 진입했으나, MACD 히스토그램은 악화되며 음전 지속. ADX 10.2로 추세 미형성 구간으로, 변동성 확대 가능성. 5일 저가 $235.96 대비 현재가 $244.43은 Higher Low 패턴 초입으로 볼 수 있으나, 20일 저가 $229.36 대비 아직 추세 전환 확정은 아님. 주봉 SMA20 $255.06 하회 중. 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI entered oversold territory, but MACD histogram continues to worsen into negative territory. ADX at 10.2 indicates a non-trending phase, suggesting potential for increased volatility. While the current price of $244.43 relative to the 5-day low of $235.96 could be seen as the start of a Higher Low pattern, it has not yet confirmed a trend reversal from the 20-day low of $229.36. Price is trading below the weekly SMA20 of $255.06. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
